Name: Standard Infantry Squad
Organization: 1 squad leader + 2 fireteams of 4 (proposed) [leader, rifleman, support, medic, rifleman, antiarmor, engineer, marksman]
Available_Commands: Follow; Move; Attack; Defend; Hold Fire; Engage Freely; Regroup; Enter Vehicle; Exit Vehicle
Behavior_Notes: Squad generally stays together but may split to maneuver

Name: Recon Squad
Organization: Leader, 3 marksmen, 2 recon (beacons, drones), 1 medic, 1 engineer [leader, marksman, marksman, recon, recon, marksman, medic, engineer]
Available_Commands: Follow; Recon Area; Mark Target; Hold Position; Regroup

Name: Support Squad
Organization: Leader, 3 support gunners, 2 medics, 2 engineers (ammo crates) [leader, support, support, support, medic, medic, engineer, engineer]

Name: Anti-Armor Squad
Organization: Leader, 4 anti-armor, 1 engineer (AV mines), 1 support, 1 medic [leader, antiarmor, antiarmor, antiarmor, antiarmor, engineer, support, medic]
Available_Commands: Follow; Attack Vehicle; Ambush; Defend; Regroup
Behavior_Notes: Prioritizes armor threats and covered firing positions
